instruction: Open the Troubleshooting Information page as a tab in Thunderbird.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened About Profiles tab by navigating hamburger menu > Help > Troubleshooting Information, scrolling down, and clicking the about:profiles link. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird hamburger menu, open Help submenu, access Troubleshooting Information, scroll pages, find and click internal about: links to open new tabs.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests a simpler variation of the same navigation: opening the Troubleshooting Information tab directly. The agent already navigated to this page as an intermediate step in the original trajectory, so this is a subset of the demonstrated capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Troubleshooting Information tab in Thunderbird (via Help menu). Evaluator checks accessibility tree for a 'Troubleshooting Information' tab in the tabmail-tabs tab list.

llm_judge_reasons: CSS selector correctly targets a page-tab named 'Troubleshooting Information' within Thunderbird's tabmail-tabs tab list, directly verifying the instruction requirement.
Getter (get_accessibility_tree) correctly extracts the live UI state needed for verification.
Metric (check_accessibility_tree) correctly parses the accessibility tree XML and applies the CSS selector to check for element existence.
Full coverage: the single instruction requirement (open Troubleshooting Information as a tab) is completely verified by the evaluator.
No postconfig needed since the tab remains open after task completion.
